prompts.prompt: how does the TCP handshake work?
prompts.why: Messages between two actors in order: sequence. A picture can only be decoration.

prompts.prompt: how does a DNS lookup work?
prompts.why: Resolver, root, TLD and authoritative servers exchange queries and answers: a sequence.

prompts.prompt: what happens when I send an email?
prompts.why: Your client, your mail server, the recipient server and their client pass the message along: a sequence. Digital: no picture.
